compute_and_update_bn_stats: compute and update batch normalization running mean and variance stats for a PyTorch model using a data loader
run_bn_stats_update: run compute_and_update_bn_stats on a model with a data loader to recalibrate batch norm statistics over 200 batches
refactor_bn_stats_accumulation: refactor compute_and_update_bn_stats to accumulate batch norm stats using an online mean and variance algorithm
review_bn_momentum_handling: review how compute_and_update_bn_stats temporarily sets momentum to 1.0 and restores original momentum values
summarize_bn_helper: summarize the bn_helper module which provides a single function to recompute precise batch normalization statistics
